headline.text: L1 S2 wrapping without approved corner boards — *all pallets* on rework hold pending Monday delivery.

summary: One active hold at window close: L1 S2 packaging without approved corner boards (40725), pallets marked rework status until Monday delivery. L1 S3 belt debris event resolved after 4-hour line stop, cleaning, and ATP pass. L1 S3 MM5 X-ray belt jam cleared and test-card verified.

holds.title: S2 pallets wrapped without approved corner boards
holds.summary: Line ran out of item 40725 corner boards; QA placed all pallets produced without corner boards on rework status pending Monday material arrival.
holds.status: Open — 2,100 corner boards arrive Monday morning, pallets will remain on rework until then.

food_safety.title: S3 belt debris found in cross conveyor 1 cover and scraper
food_safety.summary: Belt debris discovered on Cross Conveyor 1 scraper and cover; line stopped, inclusion hopper emptied, tunnel 1 inspected for FM, edges burned, area cleaned/sanitized, ATP passed.
food_safety.status: Resolved — ATP passed at 2026-08-21T21:00:45.565Z, operations resumed.

quality.title: S3 MM5 X-ray outfeed belt stopped — product bag jammed in gears
quality.summary: MM5 X-ray belt stopped; maintenance found product bag trapped underneath belt in gears, cleared, X-ray test cards passed verification.
quality.status: Resolved — belt cleared, X-ray verified with test cards, normal operations resumed at 2026-08-21T18:52:10.094Z.

quality.title: MFM bag-detection sensor failure — product falling outside pouch
quality.summary: Sensor detecting bag position for filling malfunctioned, causing product to fall outside the bag; maintenance notified and corrected.
quality.status: Resolved — maintenance corrected sensor issue, line resumed normal operations.
